Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.164.1.tgz
Pinned to the version used by the local mbd-playground web demo.

Fly Lab room geometry in the Environment 3 recording comes from
https://github.com/kalebbennaveed/NeuralDualgtk-rigid at commit
94bcefcb09bd76cca93792a0154cdbb07e77a66a, GPL-3.0 (LICENSE-flylab.txt).
Original asset: ndg_rigid/lotf/objects/path_files/rooms/track_flylab_research_3.json.
The local adaptation repositions the three gates and replaces their mounts;
other solid room geometry is preserved. Full provenance and adapted source
are in src/drone_racing/_vendor/flylab and src/drone_racing/flylab.py in the
autonomous-drone-racing-local repository.
